title: Ajwa Projects IPO Details
intro:
Ajwa Projects IPO is a fixed issue price of ₹38.05 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 15.00 lakh shares aggregating to ₹30.45 crores and offer for sale of 3.74 lakh shares aggregating to ₹7.60 crores.

Ajwa Projects IPO opens for subscription on Oct 28, 2026 and closes on Oct 30, 2026. The allotment for the Ajwa Projects IPO is expected to be finalized on Nov 2, 2026. Ajwa Projects IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Nov 4, 2026.

Ajwa Projects IPO is set final issue price at ₹203 per share. The lot size for an application is 600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,43,600 (1,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (1,800 shares), amounting to ₹3,65,400.

Wealth Mine Networks Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Prabhat Financial Services Ltd.

Refer to Ajwa Projects IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2011, Ajwa Projects is a multi-disciplinary industrial services company delivering end-to-end solutions across fabrication, erection, piping, pressure equipment, prefabricated structures, civil construction, and maintenance. The company specializes in turning project plans into real, functional industrial assets. The company manufacture technological frameworks, industrial buildings, girders, heavy modules, platforms, and crane girders that are critical for plant construction and infrastructure projects. They also fabricate specialised components such as dish ends, crowns, petals, and customised parts, including diesel engine components for railway applications that require a high degree of precision and strict compliance with industry standards.

The company caters to a wide range of industries such as oil & gas, petrochemicals, refineries, power generation, steel, heavy metals, cement, nuclear power, bridges, metro rail, bullet train infrastructure, and other industrial and infrastructure projects.
It has a workforce of over 557 skilled and semi-skilled professionals.
strengths: Strong and diverse Order Book: As of Sep 30, 2025, its order book stood at Rs 1,982.05 lakhs.

Updated on Oct 28, 2026 Incorporated in 2011, Ajwa Projects is a multi-disciplinary industrial services company delivering end-to-end solutions across fabrication, erection, piping, pressure equipment, prefabricated structures, civil construction, and maintenance. The company specializes in turning project plans into real, functional industrial assets. The company manufacture technological frameworks, industrial buildings, girders, heavy modules, platforms, and crane girders that are critical for plant construction and infrastructure projects. They also fabricate specialised components such as dish ends, crowns, petals, and customised parts, including diesel engine components for railway applications that require a high degree of precision and strict compliance with industry standards. Key Services: Fabrication: Manufacture and sell structural components, pressure vessels, boilers, tanks, ducts, and precision parts for various industries. Erection: On-site installation and integration of heavy structures, equipment, and piping systems with strict focus on safety and precision. Piping: Fabrication and installation of process and utility pipelines for chemicals, gases, steam, and fluids. Pressure Equipment: Fabrication, assembly, and erection of pressure vessels and related heavy-duty equipment. Civil Construction: Site development, foundations, industrial buildings, silos, tanks, and other civil works. Prefabricated Structures: Modular and portable buildings for industrial and commercial use. Maintenance & Mechanical Services: Preventive maintenance, PSV calibration, NDT testing, blasting & painting, and plant shutdown support. The company caters to a wide range of industries such as oil & gas, petrochemicals, refineries, power generation, steel, heavy metals, cement, nuclear power, bridges, metro rail, bullet train infrastructure, and other industrial and infrastructure projects. It has a workforce of over 557 skilled and semi-skilled professionals. faqs.question: How to apply in Ajwa Projects IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Ajwa Projects IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Ajwa Projects IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Ajwa Projects IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .

faqs.question: How to apply for Ajwa Projects IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Ajwa Projects IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The Ajwa Projects IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Nov 4, 2026 .
